package calibrated
namespace calibrated
entity Integer id "calibrated://integer"
entity Reading id "calibrated://reading" fields {
    field energy id "calibrated://reading/energy" type integer required one
    field elevated id "calibrated://reading/elevated" type boolean required one
    field label id "calibrated://reading/label" type string required one
}
activity Energy(Integer) -> Integer computes `let calibrated = __GOOO_BODY_HOLE_calibration__
return calibrated * calibrated` assembling {
    search hole "calibration" grammar "integer-hole-quadratic/v1" intent "원시값을 두 배 하고 1을 더한 값의 제곱을 구한다. Square the reading after scaling it by two and adding one." max_candidates "16"
    case "1" -> "9"
    case "2" -> "25"
    case "3" -> "49"
    case "4" -> "81"
    case "5" -> "121"
    case "6" -> "169"
    case "7" -> "225"
    case "8" -> "289"
    case "9" -> "361"
    case "10" -> "441"
    attempts "8"
}
activity Report(Integer) -> Reading computes `return Reading{energy: 0, elevated: false, label: "pending"}` assembling {
    choice "energy" field_value at "0" alternative "input" intent "계산한 제곱값을 보존한다. Preserve the computed squared reading."
    choice "elevated" field_value at "1" alternative "input >= 400" intent "제곱값이 400 이상인지 표시한다. Mark values at least 400 as elevated."
    choice "label" field_value at "2" alternative "\"calibrated\"" intent "보정한 기록으로 표시한다. Label the reading calibrated."
    value_case "[9]" -> "{\"energy\":9,\"elevated\":false,\"label\":\"calibrated\"}"
    value_case "[441]" -> "{\"energy\":441,\"elevated\":true,\"label\":\"calibrated\"}"
    attempts "8"
}
bind Energy.result -> Report.input
